senses.gloss:
मोच मोछ (vb. मुच् + अ),
 I. m. A tree, Hyperanthera morunga.
 II. f. चा.
 1. The silk cotton-tree.
 2. The plantain.
 III. n. Its fruit.

मोचक मोछक, i. e.
 A. मोछ + क, m. = मोछ,
 I.,
 II.
 B. मुच् + अक, m.
 1. A devotee, free from worldly passion and desire.
 2. A liberator.
मोचन मोछन, i. e. मुच् + अन, n. Liberating, liberation, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 10; Lass. 39, 20.
